title: Client portal redesign
summary: Meridian Supply needs a clearer way for its wholesale customers to track orders and manage their accounts. Alder & Co. will redesign the client portal around these daily tasks and deliver a tested implementation.
deliverables:
A review of the existing ordering journey and a prioritized set of improvements.
Responsive account, order history, and shipment tracking screens.
An accessible React interface integrated with the existing order API.
Handover documentation and a recorded walkthrough for the internal team.
timeline: Six weeks from kickoff: one week for discovery, two for interface design, two for implementation, and one for testing and handover.
assumptions: Meridian will provide API access and sample order data before kickoff. One consolidated feedback round is included at each milestone. Copywriting, branding changes, and payment processing are outside this scope.
